name: Hoshea
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Hoshea son of Elah conspires against Pekah, smites and slays him, and reigns in his stead.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years. Hoshea was the king of the northern kingdom. He began to reign in Samaria.
Hoshea son of Elah reigns nine years over Israel in Samaria and does evil, though not as the kings before him.

note.label: 2 Kings 17: The Carrying Away of Israel

points: Shalmaneser king of Assyria comes up, and Hoshea becomes his servant and pays tribute.

note.label: 2 Kings 17: The Carrying Away of Israel

points: The king of Assyria finds conspiracy in Hoshea because he sent messengers to So king of Egypt and stopped his yearly tribute, so he shuts him up in prison.

note.label: 2 Kings 17: The Carrying Away of Israel

points: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria. The king of Assyria took Samaria captive.
Assyria besieges Samaria three years, then in the ninth year of Hoshea takes it and carries Israel away to Assyria, placing them in Halah, Habor, and the cities of the Medes.

note.label: 2 Kings 17: The Carrying Away of Israel

points: Hezekiah son of Ahaz begins to reign over Judah in the third year of Hoshea, the last king of Israel before the captivity.

note.label: 2 Kings 18: Hezekiah and the Assyrian Threat
